menu_options.discover_switches: Scan the network for network switches

manual.title: Add SNMP device
manual.description: Connect a device by its IP address. You can add sensors for it afterwards.

discover_printers.title: Scan the network for printers
discover_printers.description: Scans a subnet for devices that answer as an SNMP printer, using SNMP v1/v2c. SNMPv3 devices must be added manually.

discover_printers_select.title: Printers found
discover_printers_select.description: {count} printer(s) found. Pick which ones to add - Model and Serial Number are shown as device info, Status/Total Pages plus one toner/ink Level sensor (in %) per marker are created automatically. Max-capacity sensors are left out by default; add one manually afterwards if needed.

discover_switches.title: Scan the network for network switches
discover_switches.description: Scans a subnet for devices that support the Bridge-MIB (i.e. respond as a managed switch), using SNMP v1/v2c. SNMPv3 devices must be added manually.

discover_switches_select.title: Switches found
discover_switches_select.description: {count} switch(es) found. Pick which ones to add - a sensor set (description, port count, one status sensor per port) is created automatically.

zeroconf_confirm.title: SNMP printer discovered
zeroconf_confirm.description: Found {model} at {host}. Add it? Model and Serial Number are shown as device info, Status/Total Pages plus one toner/ink Level sensor (in %) per marker are created automatically.

abort.already_in_progress: Discovery for this device is already in progress.
abort.not_printer: This device doesn't respond to SNMP and can't be set up automatically.
abort.invalid_subnet: That doesn't look like a valid subnet (e.g. 192.168.1.0/24).
abort.subnet_too_large: That subnet is too large to scan.
abort.no_printers_found: No SNMP printers were found on that subnet.
abort.no_switches_found: No SNMP-managed network switches were found on that subnet.

error.subnet_too_large: That subnet is too large to scan.

error.no_switches_found: No SNMP-managed network switches were found on that subnet.
